findings.description: All 12 open PRs are authored by AetherLogosPrime-Architect; the gate requires an APPROVED review from that same login; GitHub does not render Approve for a PR author. Unsatisfiable by construction, reported as an ordinary failure. Fix adds an operator approval-by-comment channel bound to the head sha.
findings.title: merge-review demanded a review GitHub cannot create for a self-authored PR

round.focus: merge-review self-approval: the gate required a review GitHub does not allow the PR author to create (PR #428)
